problem: isiZulu 'cishe' for 'about'; locative concord 'umhlaba ... kuyo' should be 'kuwo'

problem: 'kwisigxina' means 'on a permanent (thing)', not 'on a pole'
repaired: Izityalo ezintathu eziyisiseko kunye: isiqu eside sokusanhlamvu, isityalo esikhwelayo kwisibonda, nesityalo sengcambu esibonakala sisemhlabeni isiqingatha.

problem: Gloss '(ohlwayelwa ngokwemvelo)' says open-pollinated means 'sown naturally' — wrong seed concept; 'yiloo idinga umhlobo' ungrammatical; 'Ubhatata' is the isiZulu class-1a form (isiXhosa 'ibhatata', class-9 concords)
repaired:
Isityalo esiyisiseko sifanelwe sisikhundla saso kuba sondla ikhaya ngaphaya kosuku lwesivuno.

Sithwala amandla okanye iprotheyini. Siyagcinwa, okanye sihlala emhlabeni side sisidinge. Kwaye rhoqo sithwala nenkumbulo yenkcubeko.

Isityalo esiyisiseko esinye sikushiya ungakhuselekanga. Ezimbini okanye ngaphezulu zikunika ukhetho xa imozulu okanye izitshabalalisi zibetha.

Lima ubuncinane ezimbini. Hayi enye.

Sesiphi isityalo esiyisiseko ekuxhomekeke kuso ikhaya lakho kakhulu ngoku? Yiloo nto engahlukumeza kakhulu ukuba ayiphumelelanga — ngoko yiyo leyo efuna iqabane.

Isityalo ngasinye esiyisiseko sikukhusela kwinto eyahlukileyo.

Umbona unika iikhalori, kwaye ugcinwa womile. Umbona we-open-pollinated (impova yawo ithwalwa ngokwendalo ngumoya okanye zizinambuzane) ukuvumela nokuba ugcine imbewu yakho, ukuba ulawula ukwahlukaniswa kwezityalo (isolation) nokukhetha (selection).

Iimbotyi ne-cowpeas zinika isivuno seprotheyini enokugcinwa.

Ibhatata iphuhlisa ukunyamezela imbalela ngokuthile emva kokuba iingcambu zokugcina sezenziwe. Ifuna amanzi kwiiveki zokuqala nangoxa iingcambu zisenziwa; uxinzelelo lwamanzi ngelo xesha lunokunciphisa isivuno. Amagqabi ayo amancinci nawo ayadleka.

Amadumbe asinda emhlabeni omanzi ngakumbi, apho ezinye izityalo eziyisiseko zilwa.

Qaphela ukuba ziyasilela kwiimeko ezahlukeneyo. Yiloo nto kanye.

Ukunyamezela akuthethi ukuba akukho nto isilelayo.

Kuthetha ukuba ukusilela okunye akuliphelisi icebo lokutya lekhaya lakho.

Isityalo esinye sisenye indawo yokusilela.

Izityalo ezimbini okanye ngaphezulu eziyisiseko zikunika iindlela ezininzi zokuqhubeka udla.

Izityalo ezahlukeneyo zisebenzisa amanzi, umhlaba namaxesha ngokwahlukeneyo. Loo mahluko yikhuseleko.

repaired: Ibhatata iphuhlisa ukunyamezela imbalela ngokuthile emva kokuba iingcambu zokugcina sezenziwe, kodwa ifuna amanzi kwangoko; amagqabi amancinci ayadleka

problem: isiZulu 'eliphuzi' (yellow) -> 'elimthubi'; 'ebhaliswe isityalo' is ungrammatical for 'registered FOR that crop' -> 'ebhaliselwe'
repaired:
Uxinzelelo lwezitshabalalisi lunyuka ngesizathu.

Izityalo ezikuxinzelelo. Isityalo esinye esilawula umhlaba. Okanye ukusetyenziswa kakhulu kweekhemikhali sele kwasusa izilwanyana ezizingelayo ebezikunceda.

Ngoko phambi kokuba unyange nantoni na, jonga yonke inkqubo.

Ngaba isityalo sinqongophele amanzi? Ngaba umhlaba ucinezelekile, okanye awunazondlo ezaneleyo? Ngaba izilwanyana ezizingelayo sele zisebenza ukusonjulula ingxaki?

Igqabi elimthubi aliyiyo ngokuzenzekelayo inambuzane. Linokuba ngamanzi, ukondliwa, okanye umonakalo wengcambu. Zazi ukuba kungoluphi phambi kokuba wenze nto.

Landela amanyathelo amane, ngokulandelelana.

Okokuqala. Jonga. Jonga indlela umonakalo obonakala ngayo, ingaphantsi legqabi, isiqu, nezityalo ezikufutshane.

Okwesibini. Khangela uxinzelelo. Ukumanza komhlaba, iingcambu, umgama phakathi kwezityalo, ukondliwa, ukuphuma kwamanzi.

Okwesithathu. Khusela abakunceda. Izinambuzane ezinceda zenza umsebenzi obungawenza wena.

Okwesine. Kuphela emva koko, yenza into — kwaye uqale ngento elula esebenzayo. Ukususa ngokwasemzimbeni, imiqobo okanye utshintsho kunakekelo lwesityalo kunokunceda. Qinisekisa ukuba isenzo sifanelana nengxaki kwaye ubone iziphumo.

Ukuba unyango luyadingeka, sebenzisa imveliso ebhaliselwe eso sityalo nesitshabalalisi, kwaye ulandele ileyibhile yayo. Oku kubandakanya iimveliso ze-neem. Jonga imiyalelo yokhuseleko nexesha lokulinda phambi kokuvuna. Musa ukuyila imixube okanye iidosi ezomeleleyo ngakumbi.

Yiba nyanisekile kuwe ngowuphi umnyathelo osoloko ewutsiba.
Ukuba unyango luyadingeka, sebenzisa imveliso ebhaliselwe isityalo nesitshabalalisi kwaye ulandele ileyibhile

problem: Correct option: 'ebhaliswe isityalo' should be 'ebhaliselwe' (registered FOR)
repaired: Imveliso ebhaliselwe isityalo nesitshabalalisi, isetyenziswe ngokweleyibhile yayo

problem: 'ayaphuzisa' is an isiZulu-based causative ('make yellow'), not 'are turning yellow'
repaired: Amagqabi eebrassica zomfama ayajika abe mthubi. Phambi kokucinga ukuba zizitshabalalisi, ufanele ajonge ntoni kuqala?

Ukuba mthubi kwamagqabi kunezizathu ezininzi eziqhelekileyo, kwaye ingxaki yezondlo zomhlaba okanye yokunisela idinga isisombululo esahlukileyo ngokupheleleyo kunesitshabalalisi — ukujonga kuqala kuphepha unyango olulahlekileyo.

problem: 'otsiba' (-tsiba = jump) used for 'steep'; 'upslope' rendered 'up the mountain'
repaired:
Olunye uhlobo lomsele (swale) yimijelo elinganayo elandela umgca wokuphakama. Unciphisa ijubane lamanzi agelekayo aze awasasaze, ukuze amanzi athile afunxeke emhlabeni ofanelekileyo. Eminye imisele yenzelwe ukuba nethambeka elincinci elilawulweyo ukuze iphathe amanzi agqithisileyo iwasingise kancinci kwindawo ekhuselekileyo apho aphumela khona. Eyiphi indlela efanelana nomhlaba wakho ixhomekeke kumhlaba, kwithambeka, ekuphumeni kwamanzi nasekuhambeni kwamanzi esaqhwithi. Cela umcebisi wasekuhlaleni oqeqeshiweyo ahlole umgca, indlela yokuphuphuma kwamanzi nendawo awafikela kuyo phambi kokuba umbe.

Umhlaba okhutshiweyo ekumbeni wenza i-berm (umqolo womhlaba) ngakwicala eliya ezantsi, apho kunokutyalwa khona imithi xa uyilo lwendawo lufanelekile.

Imithi etyalwe apho isenokusebenzisa ukufuma okugcinwe emhlabeni emva kwemvula, kuxhomekeke kwindawo.

Imvula enkulu isenokugcwalisa umsele ngokukhawuleza kunokuba amanzi afunxeke emhlabeni. Cwangcisa indlela ekhuselekileyo yokuphuphuma kwamanzi phambi kokuba umbe.

Indlela yamanzi mayingawonakalisi ithambeka okanye ithumele amanzi anokonakalisa kummelwane. Umsele okanye idama elingezantsi kufuneka likwazi ukuwamkela ngokukhuselekileyo.

Cela umcebisi wasekuhlaleni oqeqeshiweyo ahlole umhlaba, ithambeka nokuhamba kwamanzi esaqhwithi. Umfanekiso awuyonto yoyilo lokwakha.

Ithambeka lodwa alikuxeleli ukuba umsele ufanelekile okanye hayi. Umhlaba, ukuphuma kwamanzi, umhlaba ongazinzanga namanzi asuka ngaphezulu kwethambeka konke kuyabaluleka.

Gcina umhlaba ugqunyiwe kakuhle. Funa uvavanyo lwasekuhlaleni phambi kokumba emhlabeni omnqantsa kakhulu, onamanzi okanye ongazinzanga. Imiqobo yengca nezitebhisi zomhlaba (iitheresi) nazo zifuna uyilo olufanele indawo.
Umfama ufuna ukulawula ukukhukuliseka komhlaba ethambekeni elimnqantsa kakhulu. Kufuneka enze ntoni phambi kokumba?
Imisele eqhelekileyo embiwe nzulu kangangoko

Idama okanye ichibi lingagcina amanzi agelekayo, kodwa inani elifumanekayo lixhomekeke kwimvula yasekuhlaleni, indawo ekhuphela amanzi (catchment), ilahleko yamanzi nokuba usebenzisa amanzi amaninzi kangakanani.

Amaxesha emvula ayahluka kulo lonke uMzantsi Afrika. Sebenzisa iirekhodi zasekuhlaleni kwaye ucwangcise amaxesha omileyo; akukho sithembiso sokuba idama liya kuhlala ligcwele.

Phambi kokutshintsha umjelo wamanzi okanye ukwakha imisebenzi yokugcina amanzi, jonga imvume efunekayo kwigunya lamanzi.

Idama lifuna uphando lwendawo noyilo olwenziwa ngumntu oqeqeshelwe oko ngokufanelekileyo. Amanzi agelekayo kwindawo ekhuphela amanzi, umhlaba, iziseko, umngcipheko ongezantsi nendlela ekhuselekileyo yokuphuphuma kwamanzi (spillway) konke kuyabaluleka.

Musa ukucinga ukuba imvula yonyaka ikuxelela ubukhulu bomkhukula okanye amanzi aya kuba nawo egcinwe.

Ukuphuphuma okungalawulwanga kunokukhukulisa kwaye kuqhekeze udonga. Cwangcisa indlela ekhuselekileyo yamanzi agqithisileyo phambi kokwakha.

Amanzi anokulahleka ngokuhwamla nangokuvuza emhlabeni. Jonga ukuphakama kwamanzi kwaye ufune ukuvuza okanye ukukhukuliseka.

Gcina indlela yokuphuphuma ingavaliwe kwaye ugcine ukugqunywa kwamabhanki njengoko kumiselwe kuyilo. Musa ukutyala imithi kudonga ledama lomhlaba.

Izilwanyana zingonakalisa amabhanki kwaye zongeze ubulongwe emanzini. Ubukho bazo abwenzi amanzi acocekileyo okanye akhuselekileyo.

Imvula iphuma ophahleni ingena emjelweni wophahla (igatara) ize ihle ngombhobho ingene kwitanki, kukho i-first-flush diverter encinci eyahlukana nombhobho ngaphambi kwetanki ukulahla amanzi okuqala angcolileyo.

problem: 'linganisa amanzi angaphumeliyo' ('measure water that does not succeed') for 'allow for water that misses the gutter'; malformed 'izophahla' and 'asiyongqiniseko'; 'okuceliweyo' = requested, not intended
repaired:
Uphahla lwakho lunokuqokelela amanzi emvula. Inani lixhomekeke kubungakanani bophahla, kwimvula nakwilahleko.

Jonga ukuba izinto zophahla zifanelekile na ekuqokeleleni amanzi emvula phambi kokuqhagamshela itanki.

Sebenzisa ubungakanani bophahla njengoko buboniwa ngaphezulu kunye neerekhodi zemvula zasekuhlaleni. Emva koko qwalasela amanzi angangeni emjelweni wophahla (igatara), aphambukiswayo okanye aphuphuma kwitanki egcweleyo.

Isixa semvula yonyaka asikuxeleli ukuba mangaphi amanzi aya kubakho ngexesha lokoma. Thelekisa amanzi onawo nokusetyenziswa okucwangcisileyo.

Amanzi asuka ophahleni anokuthwala uthuli, ubulongwe nokunye ukungcola. I-first-flush diverter (isixhobo esiphambukisa amanzi okuqala) igcina inxalenye yamanzi okuqala ingangeni kwitanki.

Ubungakanani bamanzi afuneka aphambukiswe buxhomekeke kuphahla nakwinkqubo. Sebenzisa imiyalelo yomthengisi yobungakanani nokugcinwa; akukho mthamo mnye ofanele lonke uphahla.

I-diverter ayiwenzi amanzi asele afanelekile ukusela.

Ubungakanani betanki buxhomekeke kwimfuno yamanzi, imvula, ubungakanani bophahla nobude bamaxesha omileyo.

Bhala ukusetyenziswa oceba ukukwenza uze uqikelele imfuno yako usebenzisa iirekhodi zakho. Thelekisa oko namanzi onawo ngamaxesha onyaka.

Cwangcisa into oya kuyenza xa amanzi agciniweyo ancipha. Igama lephondo ngokwalo alinakukuxelela ubungakanani betanki obuyifunayo.

Gcina itanki igqunyiwe, gquma imingxuma ngesikrini ukuthintela izinambuzane, kwaye ugcine uphahla, igatara ne-diverter. Gcina amanzi emvula eyahlukile kwimibhobho yamanzi okusela.

Amanzi abonakala ecocekile asenokuba namagciwane okanye iikhemikhali. Buza kwigunya lezempilo lasekuhlaleni malunga novavanyo nokucoca okufanelekileyo ekusetyenzisweni okucetywayo.

Isihluzi esiyisiseko sodwa asisosiqinisekiso yamanzi okusela. Amanzi asetyenziswa kwizityalo zokutya nawo afuna uvavanyo lokhuseleko.
Linganisa kwaye ugcine i-first-flush diverter ngokophahla lakho
Uvavanyo nokucoca kufuneka kungqamane nokusetyenziswa okucetywayo

problem: 'amanzi asetyenziswayo' = water USED; English compares usable SUPPLY with demand — the comparison collapses to use vs demand; plus concord 'lithelekise' for class-11 'ucwangciso'
repaired: Ucwangciso lwetanki kufuneka luthelekise amanzi afumanekayo nemfuno ngamaxesha emvula nawokoma. Ubungakanani obumiselweyo bommandla omnye abunakukwenza oko.
Ane-asidi eninzi ngakumbi kwaye atshintsha i-pH yomhlaba ngokuhamba kwexesha
Ukuphambukisa amanzi okuqala emvula kunganciphisa ukungcoliseka, kodwa akuqinisekisi ukuba amanzi alandelayo akhuselekile. Vavanya umgangatho wamanzi ngokokusetyenziswa okucetywayo.

problem: Final sentence says seek 'hired' advice ('eqeshiweyo') instead of qualified/trained; 'okuceliweyo' = requested, not intended
repaired:
Amanzi asetyenzisiweyo ekhaya anokuba namagciwane, ityuwa, iimveliso zokucoca nezinye izinto. Izikhokelo azichazi umthombo ngamnye ngendlela efanayo. Izikhokelo zaseMzantsi Afrika ziyahluka malunga namanzi asekhitshini namanzi okuhlamba iimpahla.

Musa ukubandakanya amanzi asetoyilethi, amanzi eediyapha, okuhlamba umntu ogulayo okanye okuhlamba izilwanyana kwicebo lokuwasebenzisa kwakhona. Musa ukuphinda usebenzise amanzi aneekhemikhali eziyingozi.

Phambi kokuphinda usebenzise, cela umasipala nomcebisi oqeqeshiweyo wasekuhlaleni wococeko ukuba ahlole umthombo ngqo, iinkonzo zamanzi nococeko zekhaya, ukusetyenziswa okucetywayo nendawo. Ukuba eli cebo alifumaneki okanye alicacanga, musa ukuphinda usebenzise amanzi.

Umfanekiso oqhelekileyo awuyonto yoyilo lwefama. Umhlaba nengca yokugquma azibulali ntsholongwane emanzini angcolileyo. Wagcine kude nemibhobho yamanzi okusela kwaye uthintele ukunxibelelana nabantu okanye izilwanyana. Musa ukuwafafaza, ukuwayeka ame, okanye ukuwavumela aphume epropathini aye esitratweni, kumjelo wamanzi okanye emlanjeni.

Ukuba inkqubo yokuphinda kusetyenziswe amanzi sele isebenza kwaye amanzi enuka kakubi, ayama, okanye alimaza izityalo, yeka ukuwasebenzisa kwaye ufune ingcebiso yomcebisi oqeqeshiweyo wasekuhlaleni.
Jonga ngokwasekuhlaleni umthombo, imeko yeenkonzo, ukusetyenziswa okucetywayo nendawo phambi kokuphinda usebenzise
Cela umasipala nomcebisi oqeqeshiweyo wococeko ukuba ahlole umthombo, imeko yeenkonzo, ukusetyenziswa okucetywayo nendawo
